text: My daily routine is quite simple and organised. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my day with a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. My work schedule is busy, but I always take a short break at noon to relax. In the afternoon, I go to the gym and exercise for about an hour, which helps me stay energetic. In the evening, I cook dinner and spend time reading or watching a film. I believe consistency is the key to a balanced life, so I try to follow this routine every day.
